_readme: S394 SkyMadrone, 2026-10-15. Diablo Valley's eLumen capture (run 38669937625) found the catalog's two hubs, transdegreecert and dvc-certs-and-degrees, and read no program page from them: the reader takes program links of the form <catalog>/program/<slug>, and these hubs link their programs some other way. Four page loads with "network": true, no model call: each hub rendered and as its publish/content call. Read 2 (run 38670917323): both hubs list no program link; dvc-certs-and-degrees is a grid of departments by award, and transdegreecert links dvcassocdegrees and ceprog. Read 3 asks those two, every link shown.

questions.program_links: How each hub links a program: the href's shape (absolute, relative, another path segment), and one program's address.
questions.hub_content: What the hub's publish/content call returns, and whether its program links match the rendered page's.
questions.award_lists: Whether dvcassocdegrees and ceprog link each program, and the href's shape.
